tools.name: mcp_usage_metering
tools.description: Record a metered usage event for any MCP tool call and return an invoice line preview (dry run)

tools.name: agent_spend_ledger
tools.description: Hosted shared spend ledger for agents: set a budget ceiling, atomically reserve before paying (never overspends, even with many agents at once), then settle or release. Idempotent. Share state by namespace

tools.name: agent_lease_lock
tools.description: Hosted distributed lease lock for agents: acquire/renew/release a named lock with a TTL and a monotonic fencing token so only one agent does a job at a time. Share state by namespace
